mapper.select: SELECT enabled, app_id, app_key, callback_url FROM auth_qq_configuration WHERE singleton = TRUE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO auth_qq_configuration(singleton, enabled, app_id, app_key, callback_url) VALUES (TRUE, #{enabled}, #{appId}, #{appKey}, #{callbackUrl}) ON CONFLICT (singleton) DO UPDATE SET enabled = EXCLUDED.enabled, app_id = EXCLUDED.app_id, app_key = EXCLUDED.app_key, callback_url = EXCLUDED.callback_url, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
